name: North American Wetlands Conservation Act (NAWCA) U.S. Standard Grants
summary: US federal matching grants for partnerships that protect, restore or enhance wetlands and nearby uplands for waterfowl and other wetland birds. Requests of $250,000 or less go to the separate NAWCA Small Grants programme; research is not funded.
reporting: Recipients file federal financial reports and programme performance reports, on the schedule set in the notice of award.
